title: OwnAI show document v1
description: The versioned JSON document emitted by `ownai show --format json` for a committed revision, standard input, or the worktree. Consumers must tolerate unknown fields: fields may be added additively within `ownai.show.v1`, so every object permits additional properties while its required fields and value constraints stay strict. A consumer must treat any `schema` value other than `ownai.show.v1` as a fatal, explicit version mismatch. Line numbers are ONE-BASED for editor friendliness; byte offsets are ZERO-BASED into the decoded UTF-8 source. `projection` is the requested mode; `outline` is mode-independent and complete, derived from the Signatures superset projection.

schema.description: The schema identifier. A mismatch is fatal.

input.description: Which input produced the document. `revision` means a committed revision; `stdin` and `worktree` mean editor-supplied bytes.

revision.description: The revision spec that was projected, or null for stdin/worktree.

mode.description: The projection mode requested on the command line.

files.description: One or more files in raw repository-path byte order.

path.description: The repository-relative path. Invalid UTF-8 bytes are escaped as \xNN.

outline.description: The mode-independent declaration outline. Every declaration appears, including ones the requested mode drops.

text.description: The exact canonical text this file emits in text mode for the requested mode.

items.description: The requested-mode projected items, including index-only nested entries.

stable_key.description: The declaration's identity within its file. Unique within this file, but not necessarily across the repository (Rust impl keys are not path-namespaced), so consumers key global state by (path, stable_key).

parent_key.description: The stable_key of the containing declaration, or null at top level.

canonical_text.description: The item's canonical fragment. A nested item's fragment carries its container indentation.

stable_key.description: The declaration's identity within its file. Unique within this file, but not necessarily across the repository (Rust impl keys are not path-namespaced), so consumers key global state by (path, stable_key).

parent_key.description: The stable_key of the containing declaration, or null at top level.

signature.description: The declaration's canonical fragment from the Signatures superset projection. A nested declaration's fragment carries its container indentation. Single line where the canonical form is single line. This is the closed-fold text only when `retained_in_mode` is false; when it is true, the mode-correct closed-fold text is the matching `projection.items[].canonical_text`, which differs for container declarations (trait/impl/module) because the requested mode may omit members the superset shows.

retained_in_mode.description: True when the requested mode's projection retains this stable_key.

start_line.description: One-based first line of the declaration node. Preceding attributes, decorators, `{-# ... #-}` pragmas, and doc comments are excluded even though `signature` may include them; an editor should extend a fold start upward over those lines. A `decorator_start_line` field may be added additively within `ownai.show.v1` later.

end_line.description: One-based last line of the declaration, including its body. For a brace language this is the closing brace; for Python it is the last line of the suite.

start_byte.description: Zero-based first byte of the declaration in the decoded UTF-8 source.

end_byte.description: Zero-based end byte (exclusive) of the declaration in the decoded UTF-8 source.

kind.description: The exhaustive declaration kind. Every ItemKind in ownai-core maps to exactly one value.
